FAILURE_TEST_phase_locking_of_selected_c.note: Points whose selected branch still yields a spring-neap-locked compound catalogue. Any count above chance in the keep_tide branch means the switch does not deliver a tide-free catalogue there.

discontinuity_at_switch.note: Relative difference between the two candidate catalogues for points bracketing q = 1; a large value means neighbouring points land on materially different counts purely because of which side of the switch they fall.
